t.text: Helm Mobile · Snoozed / Settled shelves on Home

annotations.text: Recommended: B. Same card as A, but when the list is short it rests just above the bar; when the list is long it simply comes after the last thread (B, long list). Never pinned on top of content.

Any variant that moves the shelves down needs tap → push a screen instead of expanding in place: 294 settled rows can't unfold below the fold. Snoozed screen sorts by wake time, Settled groups by day.
